notes: Modified cash basis city, year ended 9/30/2022. Governmental lines from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4, Total Governmental Funds column); fund balances 2,029,856 -> 1,829,830 in *_fund_balance; ending_cash = sum of cash lines on the governmental funds balance sheet (p3), certificates of deposit 205,272 in ending_investments; beginning cash not printed. Taxes 828,000 has no breakdown that ties (Statement of Activities p2 general receipts: property/in lieu/motor vehicle 465,649 + sales and use 369,806 + occupation 7,926 = 843,381): Local Option Sales Tax fund column split as sales tax by fund name, remainder kept as taxes. Transfers: Street column in 21,159, General column out (240,939); Total column (219,780) is the net transfer to the Electric fund (business_type.transfers_net +219,780). Proceeds from sale 3,687 in other_financing. 'Community subdivision' (Other Governmental fund, called 'CRA subdivision' on budget schedule p8) recorded as economic development; capital outlay 10,334 has no printed function, labelled 'Capital Outlay'. Business-type lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Net Position - Business-type Activities (p6, Total column), as in FY2023/FY2024: measure net position, beginning 2,509,456, ending 3,178,443; nonoperating investment earnings 454, grant income 102,741 (Water; grantor not printed, generic intergovernmental) and interest expense 2,889 recorded as lines; totals computed from operating + nonoperating. The modified cash Statement of Activities (p2) shows business-type net position 1,531,158 -> 1,905,907 (cash basis), which is the business-type balance on the Statement of Net Position (p1). Proprietary Statement of Cash Flows (p7) is printed but proprietary is null, as in FY2023/FY2024 (modified cash basis report). Detail: the only supplementary schedule is a combined all-funds budget schedule (p8, one line per fund), so detail is one line per fund column of the governmental funds statement (p4) and the business-type activities statement (p6); nonoperating lines and the transfer are outside the printed operating totals. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3, totals equal government-wide 1,829,830), business-type lines from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1).
